newsitem.title: UK: Tesco says talks on Quinnsworth continue.
newsitem.headline: Tesco says talks on Quinnsworth continue.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc said on Thursday that talks with Associated British Foods (ABF) on the possible purchase of Irish supermarket chains owned by the food manufacturer were continuing.
"The two boards are involved in ongoing talks," a spokeswoman for Tesco said.
Irish newspapers said on Thursday that Tesco was close to clinching a deal for ABF's Quinnsworth Group, Ireland's biggest food retailer, for around 600 million Irish pounds.
The reports said the deal would also include the Crazy Prices and Stewarts operations in Northern Ireland, also owned by ABF.
The Tesco spokeswoman said she could give no further comment on the talks.
A report in the Financial Times newspaper had said the talks had collapsed. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
